description: Misty Balloons watercolour mural 5056x3392: two hot-air balloons (the big one on the right glows warm from inside), a flock of birds, a fog-covered pine forest in the lower third; pale blue sky with a lilac-peach glow, sage green and grey-lilac haze. Calm, dreamy, soft; no pink, no bright blue: neutral. The balloons and birds are in the upper part of the wall, the forest in the lower part, so a child standing in the room covers only the trees.
